fieldValues.title: Retire Foundation Group (Core) section-type record to concept (RFC-042 Change B, srs#710 subset)
fieldValues.summary: Retyped com.semanticops.spec/section record "Foundation Group (Core)" (19 contains children, the smaller of the two sections PR #721 deferred for edge-count) to a com.semanticops.spec/concept: created the successor concept, asserted derived-from new->old, moved the Part-contains edge, the precedes edge, and all 19 contains-child edges from old to new, resynced the Foundations Part container membership, and added one publication-reachability-exclusions.json + one spec-coherence-allowlist.json (no-orphan-leaf) entry, each proven red-without/green-with. validate-all.mjs: 0 errors, 12 warnings (unchanged baseline).
fieldValues.body:
Dispatched from srs gate:dispatched (issue #710) via srs#580 queue, re-pulled at coordinator discretion after PR #721 (comment 5609510877/5611190504). Continues the coherent-subset pattern PR #721 established: this unit retypes the smaller of the two remaining `section` records that #721 deferred for edge-count (Foundation Group (Core), 19 contains children; Extensions, 35 children, remains deferred to a follow-up unit). Mode complicated, Cell Containment, Door 1 (executes Accepted RFC-042 Change B, rfc-decision-5f8204bc), gate:auto-merge.

New concept e4837800-1803-4b0b-9a9f-08ff3e5cb95a (canonical_key record:concepts/foundation-group-core) carries the old section's title and content verbatim. Old record 74746626-1a15-5430-931e-90a147961265 kept as a catalogued, unreachable record (not deleted) per the established pattern — the derived-from relation needs a live target and no identity-preserving retype tool exists yet (srs#178, OPEN).

Remaining for srs#710 after this unit: Extensions (1 section record, 35 contains children), all 65 subsection records, and the final `srs type delete` PR once both counts hit zero — that deletion also needs to resolve the tension carried-context-0bf0c680 already flags: the successor pattern never deletes retired records (kept as derived-from targets), so `srs record list --type section`/`subsection` returning zero may require either a future bulk-purge verb or a deliberate decision to break the derived-from back-reference at that final step. Not this unit's to resolve — flagging it forward.

validate-all.mjs passed clean on this branch (0 errors, all checks including the previously-flagged versioning-cell check green — the srs#658 stale-allowlist-entry failure reported by four sessions on 2026-09-09 did not reproduce here).
